name: SEO Audit & Fix Plan
description: Full SEO audit with prioritized fixes and a 90-day improvement roadmap

steps.task: Conduct a comprehensive SEO audit for {{business_name}} at {{website_url}}. Industry: {{industry}}, Location: {{target_location}}. Analyze: current keyword rankings, on-page SEO (titles, meta, headers, content), technical SEO (speed, mobile, crawlability, schema), local SEO (GMB, citations, reviews), backlink profile, and competitor comparison vs {{main_competitors}}. Identify the top 10 highest-impact issues.

Based on the SEO audit for {{business_name}}, build the keyword strategy. Research: primary keywords, long-tail opportunities, local intent keywords for {{target_location}}, content gap analysis vs {{main_competitors}}, and search volume/difficulty estimates. Produce a target keyword list with priority tiers.

Create the technical SEO fix checklist for {{website_url}}. For each issue identified in the audit: provide the exact fix, the file/page to edit, estimated difficulty (easy/medium/hard), and expected impact. Include: meta tag templates for all pages, schema markup code for {{industry}}, and structured data recommendations.

Review {{website_url}} for UX/conversion issues that affect SEO signals. Analyze: page structure, internal linking, CTA placement, content readability, above-the-fold content, and user trust signals. Propose specific copy and layout improvements for the top 5 pages.

Compile the full SEO audit report and 90-day roadmap for {{business_name}}. Include: executive summary, current baseline metrics, prioritized fix list (quick wins, medium-term, long-term), monthly milestone targets, and success metrics to track. Format as a client-deliverable report.
